topics.titleTr: Kod Olarak Politika: Kubernetes'te OPA vs Kyverno
topics.titleEn: Policy as Code: OPA vs Kyverno for Kubernetes
topics.angle: comparison: which admission-control policy engine to adopt
topics.brief: Outline: what policy-as-code solves (guardrails, compliance, config-drift prevention) and why it matters as AI agents start opening PRs and changing infra; OPA/Gatekeeper with Rego vs Kyverno's Kubernetes-native YAML; the learning curve and tooling of each; authoring and unit-testing policies; enforcing at CI time vs at admission time in the cluster; mutation and generation rules; migration effort and operational cost; and a decision matrix for small teams. Verify current OPA Gatekeeper and Kyverno capabilities and CNCF status. Sources: Kyverno docs (kyverno.io) and Open Policy Agent docs (openpolicyagent.org).

topics.titleTr: Hucre Tabanli Mimari: Patlama Yaricapini Kucult
topics.titleEn: Cell-Based Architecture: Shrink the Blast Radius
topics.angle: deep-dive: a resilience pattern that isolates failures
topics.brief: Outline: what a 'cell' is (an isolated, independently deployable slice of the whole stack); how cells cap blast radius and prevent correlated failure; routing and sharding users to cells; trade-offs (cost, deployment complexity, data partitioning); when a small team should and should not adopt it. Verify AWS and industry definitions of cell-based architecture and the resilience framing. Sources: AWS Well-Architected cell-based write-ups and https://www.infoq.com/articles/cloud-devops-trends-2026/.

topics.titleTr: Gemini Ogrenci Merkeziyle Daha Verimli Calis
topics.titleEn: Study Smarter With Gemini's New Student Hub
topics.angle: how-to: build an active-recall study loop with the Student Hub
topics.brief: Outline: what the Student Hub is (study notebook, flashcards, practice quizzes); setting up a subject; turning lecture notes into active recall; a spaced-repetition weekly loop; using it to learn rather than to cheat (honesty guardrails); availability for Google Workspace for Education users. Verify the Student Hub feature set and the Education rollout dates. Sources: https://blog.google/ (Gemini) and Gemini Apps Help (support.google.com/gemini).

topics.titleTr: Claude ya da ChatGPT ile Haftani 30 Dakikada Planla
topics.titleEn: Plan Your Week With Claude or ChatGPT in 30 Minutes
topics.angle: how-to: a repeatable weekly planning and review ritual with an assistant
topics.brief: Outline: the Friday-30 ritual; dumping tasks and notes and letting the assistant cluster by priority and effort; time-blocking against the calendar; a reflection prompt that closes the week; stopping it from inventing commitments; saving it as a reusable project/skill so you don't re-prompt. Verify the ChatGPT Projects/memory and Claude Projects features used. Sources: OpenAI ChatGPT release notes (help.openai.com) and Anthropic Claude docs.

topics.titleTr: ChatGPT ve Gemini ile Kalici E-posta Triyaji
topics.titleEn: Inbox Triage With ChatGPT and Gemini: Rules That Stick
topics.angle: how-to: build durable triage rules, not one-off inbox cleanups
topics.brief: Outline: why 'clean my inbox' prompts don't last; a triage taxonomy (reply / defer / delegate / drop); wiring Gmail and Outlook via ChatGPT plugins/connectors and Gemini in Workspace; reusable draft-reply templates; a daily ten-minute pass; the privacy limits of letting AI read your mail. Verify ChatGPT multi-account plugin connectors and Gemini Workspace capabilities. Sources: OpenAI help release notes and Google Workspace Updates (workspaceupdates.googleblog.com).

topics.titleTr: Instagram'in Kopya Icerik Erisim Cezasini Asmak
topics.angle: how-to: avoid near-duplicate detection and repost the right way
topics.brief: Outline: Instagram now downranks duplicate and near-duplicate (lightly edited) reposts; the reach cliff for accounts posting fewer than ~4 Reels/week (reportedly ~23% lower reach); how to genuinely re-cut vs re-upload; watermark/source traps when recycling across apps; a weekly cadence that stays above the penalty. Verify the duplicate-detection claim, the ~23% figure, and the 4-Reels threshold. Sources: https://storychief.io/blog/social-media-algorithms-2026 and https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-algorithm/.

topics.titleTr: Izlenme Suresi ve Tamamlama: Sizi Siralayan Sinyaller
topics.titleEn: Dwell Time and Completion: The Signals That Rank You
topics.angle: data-led: why these now outrank likes across platforms
topics.brief: Outline: the shift from follow-graph to interest-graph recommendation, where content must earn distribution and followers no longer guarantee reach; why dwell time and completion rate are the two most under-reported ranking signals and now outweigh likes on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn; how to design hooks, pacing, length, and loops for completion rather than for the like button; where to read these signals in each platform's native analytics; and which vanity metrics to stop optimizing for. Verify the cross-platform dwell/completion weighting claim. Sources: https://storychief.io/blog/social-media-algorithms-2026 and https://www.digitalapplied.com/blog/how-social-media-algorithms-work-2026.

topics.titleTr: Markalar TikTok'un Yapay Zeka Avatarlarini Kullanmali mi?
topics.titleEn: Should Brands Use TikTok's AI Avatar Influencers?
topics.angle: contrarian: the case for and against synthetic 24/7 hosts
topics.brief: Outline: what AI avatar influencers are (synthetic hosts promoting products around the clock, often in livestream shopping); where they help (volume, cost, always-on) vs where they hurt (trust, disclosure duties, AI-content labeling rules); cost vs human creators; a disclosure/compliance checklist before deploying one. Verify TikTok's AI-avatar push and current AI-content labeling requirements. Sources: https://www.socialpilot.co/blog/social-media-updates and the TikTok newsroom.

topics.titleTr: TikTok'un Yeni Reklam Formatlari: TopReach ve Prime Time
topics.titleEn: TikTok's New Ad Formats: TopReach, Prime Time, Pulse
topics.angle: guide: what each new format is and when it's worth the buy
topics.brief: Outline: what each new format is and the job it does: TopReach (one buy combining TopView + TopFeed for full-day reach), Logo Takeover, Prime Time (up to three sequential ads in a 15-minute window), and Pulse Mentions; how to match each to a reach vs performance objective; which budget tiers each format realistically fits and which small advertisers should skip entirely; how to measure incremental lift rather than last-click; and a quick buying framework. Verify each format's definition, pricing model, and availability. Sources: https://www.socialpilot.co/blog/social-media-updates and TikTok for Business.

topics.titleTr: Canli Yayinda Satis: Kucuk Markalar Icin 2026 Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Livestream Shopping: A 2026 Playbook for Small Brands
topics.angle: guide: run a profitable live shopping session on a small budget
topics.brief: Outline: why livestream commerce plus in-app mini-apps are turning TikTok and Instagram into entertainment-plus-shopping hybrids; planning a profitable show (hero offers, host energy, a tight run-of-show); the minimum tech and streaming setup a small brand needs; converting viewers in real time with pinned products, limited drops, and urgency; repurposing the recording into short clips that keep selling afterward; and the unit economics that tell you whether to run it again. Verify the TikTok livestream-shopping and mini-app commerce trend. Sources: https://www.socialpilot.co/blog/social-media-updates and https://www.adobe.com/express/learn/blog/2026-social-media-trends.

topics.titleTr: Icerik Ureticisi Whitelisting: UGC'yi Reklama Cevir
topics.titleEn: Creator Whitelisting: Turn UGC Into Paid Ads
topics.angle: how-to: run ads from creators' own handles (Spark Ads / partnership ads)
topics.brief: Outline: what whitelisting is (serving ads from the creator's own handle via TikTok Spark Ads / Meta partnership ads); why it outperforms brand-handle ads (social proof, native feel); setting up access and permissions; creative-rights and usage terms to agree up front; measurement; pitfalls (access revocation, disclosure). Verify Spark Ads and Meta partnership-ad mechanics. Sources: TikTok for Business Spark Ads docs and Meta Business Help Center.

topics.titleTr: ChatGPT'nin Yeni Kamerasi: Belge Tara, Fotoyla Alisveris
topics.titleEn: ChatGPT's New Camera: Scan Docs and Shop by Photo
topics.angle: guide: what the new camera, scanning and shopping tools actually do
topics.brief: Outline: capturing multiple pages in a row that auto-combine into a single PDF; smarter scanning; virtual try-on for clothes and accessories; a Favorites feature for saving products; real use cases (receipts, documents, shopping) and the limits; privacy of camera data; how to enable it. Verify the October 1, 2026 camera-scanning, virtual try-on, and Favorites updates. Sources: ChatGPT release notes (help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453) and releasebot OpenAI updates.

topics.titleEn: What Is Gemini Live Guided Vision?
topics.angle: explainer: point your camera and get real-time step-by-step help
topics.brief: Outline: what Guided Vision adds to Gemini Live (real-time camera input plus spoken, step-by-step guidance); use cases (repairs, cooking, accessibility, shopping); how it differs from plain image Q&A; device support and the late-September-to-early-October 2026 rollout; the privacy implications of streaming live video to an assistant. Verify the feature scope and rollout window. Sources: https://blog.google/ (Gemini) and releasebot Gemini updates.

topics.titleTr: Akilli Gozluk ve Riza: Atladigimiz Gorgu Kurallari
topics.titleEn: Smart Glasses and Consent: The Etiquette We Skipped
topics.angle: contrarian: hardware raced ahead of the consent problem
topics.brief: Outline: the three-tier glasses market (AI camera eyewear, tethered AR, standalone AR computers); why always-on cameras break bystander consent; recording-indicator 'theater' vs real social norms; how laws lag the hardware; practical etiquette for wearers, hosts, and venues. Verify the AWE 2026 three tiers, the ~3.34M-to-32M unit forecast, and the rising consent concerns. Sources: https://www.abiresearch.com/blog/consumer-technology-trends-2026 and Next Reality's AWE 2026 coverage.

topics.titleTr: Artik Her Yerde RCS: SMS'in Sonu mu?
topics.titleEn: RCS Is Everywhere Now: The End of SMS?
topics.angle: explainer: what cross-platform RCS adoption means for you
topics.brief: Outline: what RCS adds over SMS (read receipts, typing indicators, high-res media, group features, encryption); the current iPhone-to-Android interop status; the rise of RCS Business Messaging (RBM) for brands; where plain SMS still wins (reliability, fallback); privacy and encryption caveats across platforms. Verify current RCS interop and end-to-end-encryption status across iOS and Android. Sources: GSMA RCS resources and Apple/Google messaging announcements.

topics.titleTr: Gemini Gems'leri 17 Kasim'dan Once Skills'e Tasi
topics.titleEn: Migrate Your Gemini Gems to Skills Before Nov 17
topics.angle: checklist: what changes, what breaks, and what to do before the cutover
topics.brief: Outline: the timeline (personal accounts from November 2026, with the app switch on Nov 17; Workspace business/enterprise March 2027; Education June 2027); what auto-migrates and what you must redo; the 100-active-skill cap; capabilities Skills don't yet support (GitHub files, Canvas, Deep Research, Guided Learning, create video/music); how slash-invoked, stackable skills change team workflows; an audit checklist. Verify the dates, the cap, and the unsupported-capability list. Sources: 'About the transition from Gems to skills' (support.google.com/gemini/answer/18560919) and TechCrunch's Gems-to-Skills report.

topics.brief: Outline: the 'team of three doing the work of ten' claim and where it holds; a decision framework (judgment, accountability, volume, risk, repeatability); tasks agents own well vs human-only work; the hidden costs of agents (oversight, error handling, tooling, drift); a staffing matrix; when you should still hire a person.
